a5_pcr_thresholds.rationale: Standard PCR interpretation: >1.5 very bearish, >1.0 bearish, >0.8 neutral, <0.8 bullish

a5_pcr_scores.rationale: Score mapping for PCR: very bearish (0.9) → bearish (0.7) → neutral (0.5) → bullish (0.1)

a5_pcr_fallback.rationale: Neutral score when PCR data is unavailable (0)

a6_oddlot_thresholds.rationale: Odd-lot imbalance ranges: heavy retail buying (>0.2), moderate (>0.1), neutral (-0.1 to 0.1), selling (<-0.1), heavy selling (<-0.2)

a6_oddlot_scores.rationale: Score mapping: heavy buying (0.85 bearish) → heavy selling (0.15 bullish)
